themes.label: Paywall/Monetization
themes.describe: Users are highly frustrated by the shift to subscription models locking away previously free features.

themes.label: Bugs & Crashes
themes.describe: Frequent reports of the app crashing, glitching, or failing to complete basic tasks like saving or collaging.

themes.label: Feature Loss/Change
themes.describe: Users miss or complain about the removal, renaming, or significant degradation of old, beloved features.

themes.label: Usability & UI
themes.describe: Complaints regarding the app becoming overly complicated, difficult to navigate, or having poor text/layout controls.

themes.label: Billing & Refunds
themes.describe: Issues related to unexpected charges, difficulty canceling subscriptions, or getting refunds.

themes.label: Compatibility & Updates
themes.describe: Problems arising from updates, including device incompatibility or the app simply not working after an update.

themes.label: Core Functionality Failure
themes.describe: The app fails at fundamental tasks like saving photos, adding images, or performing basic edits.

themes.label: Customer Support
themes.describe: Negative experiences with customer service regarding support requests or billing disputes.

themes.label: Praise
themes.describe: Reviews that express general satisfaction with the app's functionality.
